qualitative.gate_2_reason: Package holiday tours, leisure airlines, and cruise ship operations are pure discretionary big-ticket travel, explicitly disqualifying under Gate 2.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). TUI operates leisure airlines, cruise lines, and package tour operations, representing big-ticket discretionary holiday spending that is completely deferrable during economic stress and explicitly disqualified under Gate 2.
qualitative.evidence: TUI's business spans airlines, cruise lines (TUI Cruises, Marella), and package tour operators. Demand is intensely cyclical and consumer-discretionary. Operating margins are historically razor-thin (2-4%), and the company required billions in German state bailouts (WSF) and catastrophic equity dilution to survive the 2020 pandemic downturn.
